clue.text: Lost island silly nit recorded in map book

indicators.note: something recorded in a book is written inside it, so these letters go within the other piece

parts.note: a book of maps is an atlas

indicators.note: silly suggests the letters are behaving foolishly and get jumbled

explanation.surface: A foolish person is said to be marked in a book of maps, near a vanished land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'silly' is the anagram signal and 'recorded in' the container signal: the jumbled insult sits inside the map book.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary sunken island described by Plato, the classic example of a lost land.

clue.text: President's superior suit

definitions.meaning: belonging to Donald Trump, the US President
in card games the suit that beats all others

explanation.surface: The head of state's outfit is better than anyone else's.
explanation.definitionFit: A possessive of the surname of a US President, and the card suit ranking above the other suits.

clue.text: Jelly made with a non-Eastern spice

indicators.note: non-Eastern means the word spice loses its letter for East

parts.note: taken as written before its letter is removed

explanation.surface: A recipe note: a jelly prepared with a flavouring not from the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: E is the abbreviation for East.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspic is a savoury gelatine in which meat or eggs are set.

clue.text: Temple too elaborate to be something Indians venerate

indicators.note: an elaborate version of something is worked over, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A shrine made overly ornate becomes an object of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved pole bearing emblems, honoured by peoples of the American Northwest Coast.

clue.text: Odd way to go over hills

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over, above, the second

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
a range is a line of hills or mountains

explanation.surface: A curious route to take across the hills.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: something strange is peculiar, out of the ordinary.

clue.text: Fraud bound to include City in retrospect

indicators.note: to include something is to take it within, so one piece goes inside the other
in retrospect means looking back, so the word for bound is read backwards

parts.note: tied means bound with rope
EC is the postcode for the City of London

explanation.surface: A swindle obliged to take in the financial district, looking back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retrospect' reverses only the word for bound, giving DEIT; 'to include' then takes in the City's postcode letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: deceit is dishonest trickery, the essence of a swindle.

clue.text: Tube holding a gold coin

indicators.note: holding means containing, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a duct is a tube or channel

explanation.surface: A pipe that has a piece of gold money stuck in it.
explanation.definitionFit: The ducat was a gold coin used across medieval and early modern Europe.

clue.text: One may be seen twisting at a party

definitions.text: One may be seen twisting at a party

parts.words: One may be seen twisting at a party
parts.note: suggests a dancer doing the Twist, but means a spiral tool turned into wine-bottle stoppers

explanation.surface: A guest spotted dancing the Twist at a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: The bottle-opening device, a twisting metal spiral, is busy whenever the wine flows at parties.

clue.text: Submarine threats that would break down if fired

definitions.text: Submarine threats that would break down if fired

parts.words: Submarine threats that would break down if fired
parts.note: suggests torpedoes, but means floating ice masses, mostly under water, that would melt away if heated

explanation.surface: Torpedoes that would fail if launched.
explanation.definitionFit: Most of a floating ice mass lies beneath the sea, a hazard to ships, and heat makes it melt.

clue.text: From which the faithful are instructed how to convert wood into paper

definitions.text: From which the faithful are instructed
definitions.meaning: the raised stand in a church from which a sermon is preached

definitions.text: how to convert wood into paper
definitions.meaning: read as an instruction: mash it into pulp, the first step in papermaking

explanation.surface: A puzzle about where congregations learn and a papermaking tip.
explanation.definitionFit: The preacher's raised platform in church, and an instruction to reduce timber to mush.

clue.text: Instrument of justice

definitions.meaning: a wooden wind instrument played in schools
a judge; in England a part-time judge holds this title

explanation.surface: A tool or means by which justice is done.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a woodwind instrument and the title of a barrister sitting as a part-time judge.

clue.text: Advertising agent who's out-of-this-world?

definitions.meaning: a salesman of advertising space in a publication
an astronaut, literally beyond the Earth

explanation.surface: An ad salesman who is simply sensational.
explanation.definitionFit: An astronaut travels beyond Earth; a newspaper's seller of ad space is also so called.

clue.text: Sampled last of fruit — fresh dates

indicators.note: last of means only the final letter of the word fruit is used
fresh means new, so these letters are formed anew

explanation.surface: Someone tried a bit of produce: the dates were fresh.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to sample food is to try a little of it.

clue.text: More than mean

parts.note: above means more than, as in above ten
the mean is the arithmetic average

explanation.surface: Not merely stingy but worse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mean' looks like stingy; here it is the statistical mean.
explanation.definitionFit: Exceeding the mean value, as in better than typical.

clue.text: Pocket money could get booze to hold sad party in Africa

indicators.note: to hold is to contain, so pieces go inside the other

parts.note: ale is beer, booze
low means downcast, sad
the ANC, African National Congress, is South Africa's ruling party

explanation.surface: A child's weekly cash might buy beer to keep a gloomy African gathering going.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: pocket money is the regular sum given to a child, an allowance.

clue.text: Brilliant featherweight

definitions.meaning: a bright signal flare fired from a pistol
read as two words: extremely low in weight

explanation.surface: A boxer in the lightest class who is superb.
explanation.definitionFit: A flare fired as a signal, and a phrase meaning hardly heavy at all.

clue.text: Residents who learn they're not invited on the ship

definitions.meaning: pupils living at a boarding school

definitions.text: they're not invited on the ship
definitions.meaning: attackers who board a vessel, like pirates

explanation.surface: Pupils living in discover they are excluded from a cruise.
explanation.definitionFit: Pupils living at school during term, and raiders who climb onto a vessel uninvited.

clue.text: Net result of all efforts coming to nought

definitions.text: Net result of all efforts coming to nought

parts.words: Net result of all efforts coming to nought
parts.note: net suggests final outcome, but means the goal net in football, which nobody hit: nil-nil

explanation.surface: The overall outcome when every effort is wasted.
explanation.definitionFit: A football match ending nil-nil, where no shots found the net.

clue.text: A word for the wise

parts.note: echoes the proverb about a hint sufficing, but means a term meaning wise

explanation.surface: A short piece of advice for those sensible enough to listen.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary term meaning wise or learned, so it is literally a word for wise.

clue.text: I will join accountants up a gum tree

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: CA stands for chartered accountant; two of them make the plural

explanation.surface: Someone will team up with the number-crunchers in a predicament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up a gum tree' is British slang for in trouble. 'up' turns CACA to ACAC.
explanation.definitionFit: The wattle tree yields gum arabic, so it is a tree that gives gum.

clue.text: Back pay for draughtsman

indicators.note: back means the word for pay is read in reverse

parts.note: a reward is a payment

explanation.surface: Arrears owed to a technical illustrator.
explanation.definitionFit: A draughtsman draws plans, so he is literally someone who draws.

clue.text: Check key's in, that's the rule

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the word for check

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain
G is a musical key

explanation.surface: Check the key is in the lock: that is the regulation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms as nouns: a monarch's reign is the period of rule.

clue.text: Sign of nervousness, one fought by the brave

definitions.meaning: a whitened countenance, as from fear
in old Westerns a white settler, enemy of the Native American warrior called a brave

explanation.surface: A nervous look is the opponent of courageous folk.
explanation.definitionFit: A blanched look of fear, and the Western-film term for a white man fought by Native warriors.

clue.text: Special aptitude one's shown for illuminating targets, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals a word that sounds the same but is spelt differently

parts.note: a flare is fired to light up a target area

explanation.surface: A talent that someone displays for lighting up objectives.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a natural knack or gift for something.

clue.text: Ungenerous period for interval

parts.note: mean means stingy, ungenerous
a period is a stretch of time

explanation.surface: A stingy stretch replaces a break.
explanation.definitionFit: The intervening time between two events, an interval.

clue.text: Look good with jousting weapon

parts.note: a knight's long spear used in jousts

explanation.surface: Appearing fine with a knight's tournament spear.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms as nouns: a glance is a quick look.

clue.text: Following ship, like seabird

parts.note: as means like, in the manner of
a tern is a gull-like seabird

explanation.surface: A gull trailing a vessel, as seabirds do.
explanation.definitionFit: Behind a vessel, at or towards the stern, as one following it would be.

clue.text: University to put in test for learning experience

indicators.note: put in places the pieces inside the word for test

parts.note: a trial is a test
taken as written

explanation.surface: A college is sent for examination as part of education.
explanation.definitionFit: A small-group teaching session with a tutor, a lesson in learning.
